title: Zesty Greek Chicken Wrap
description: A quick, herbal chicken wrap packed with zesty Greek flavors and a hangover‑cure kick, featuring fresh salsa and a creamy tzatziki sauce.
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium heat and add the olive oil.
Season the chicken strips with salt, pepper, oregano, minced garlic, and lemon juice, tossing to coat.
Cook the chicken for 5-6 minutes until browned and cooked through, stirring occasionally.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and let it rest for 1 minute.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet for 30 seconds on each side.
Spread a spoonful of tzatziki sauce over each tortilla.
Place the cooked chicken on the tortilla.
Top the chicken with diced tomato, cucumber, and crumbled feta cheese.
Drizzle a little extra lemon juice over the fillings for added zing.
Fold the sides of the tortilla over the filling and roll tightly into a wrap.
Slice the wrap in half and serve immediately.
Optionally sprinkle extra feta and serve with a side of Greek yogurt.
